artwork_branch.text: Original gallery installation study: one translucent sheet suspended in a quiet space; a narrow beam of light shifts the perceived object boundary. Establish the optical mechanism, not an imitation of a named artwork.

shot_branch.text: A technician approaches the hanging translucent sheet and moves a handheld light slowly across it. Locked 50 mm camera; one uninterrupted 6-second action; finger-light-sheet spatial relationship must remain legible.

spatial_invariants: handheld light, technician and suspended sheet remain in one coherent gallery space
physical_invariants: light moves continuously; sheet remains physically suspended
forbidden_outcomes: sheet changes into a solid sculpture
camera cuts to an unrelated location

artwork.observable: light creates a visible and plausible perceptual edge change on the sheet

shot.observable: technician's hand visibly moves the light across the same hanging sheet

fused.observable: both artwork optical mechanism and shot action are independently legible in one composition
